title: mimulus crinitus
intro: Mimulus crinitus, commonly known as Bear's Ear, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Phrymaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus crinitus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Its bioactive constituents include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
